items.a: Não. O plano grátis não pede cartão e não tem prazo para acabar.
No app, na tela Plano, que abre pelo botão do perfil no topo do Início. No iPhone, a cobrança é feita pela App Store; no Android, pelo Google Play.
Não, é por empresa. A equipe toda usa o mesmo plano, até o número de pessoas dele.
Pode, quando quiser, pela mesma tela Plano. Se a equipe crescer, é só subir de plano.
Você paga 10 meses e usa 12. A cobrança é uma vez por ano.

Peça em até 7 dias da assinatura e devolvemos o dinheiro. No iPhone, o pedido é feito à Apple, que decide a devolução, em reportaproblem.apple.com. Depois disso, você pode cancelar quando quiser e usa até o fim do período pago.

guarantee.title: 7-day guarantee
guarantee.text: Subscribed and found it is not for you? Ask within 7 days of subscribing, no questions asked. On the web and on Android, we refund the full amount. On iPhone, Apple charges the subscription: the request goes to Apple, and Apple decides. We show you how.
guarantee.link: See how to ask in the terms of use

rules.title: How limits work
rules.lede: No surprises in the middle of a job.

items.title: Your biggest number decides
items.text: The right plan is the one that covers your work orders for the month and the people on your team.

items.title: A heads-up, never a lockout
items.text: We let you know when you get close to the limit and when you pass it. Went over the limit this month? Work orders keep opening. Only if last month was over too does a new work order wait for a plan change. No open work order ever locks.

items.title: Everyday work is in every plan
items.text: Opening work orders, sending them to the customer, approval by link, the schedule and importing data are in every plan, free included.

items.title: Photos and AI in every plan
items.text: Take as many photos as the job needs and fill in the work order by voice or photo, on any plan, free included.

compare.title: Compare plans
compare.caption: Limits for each plan
compare.footnote: * On Business, after 500 work orders in a month, R$ 99 per extra 100; after 20 people, R$ 15 per person.

items.q: Do I need a card to start?
items.a: No. The free plan asks for no card and never runs out.
In the app, on the Plan screen, opened from the profile button at the top of Home. On iPhone, the App Store charges you; on Android, Google Play does.
No, it is per company. The whole team shares the same plan, up to its number of people.
Yes, whenever you want, on the same Plan screen. If your team grows, just move up a plan.

items.q: How does the yearly plan work?
items.a: You pay for 10 months and use 12. You are billed once a year.

items.q: What if I change my mind?
items.a: Ask within 7 days of subscribing and we refund you. On iPhone, you ask Apple, which decides on the refund, at reportaproblem.apple.com. After that, you can cancel at any time and keep using it until the end of the paid period.
